We need to produce proper tool call. Let's call search_template_catalog_by_criteria with molecule_smiles = "CC(C)(C)C(=O)c1ccc(Br)cc1". functional_groups_broken = ["aliphatic hydroxyl"]? But the target doesn't have hydroxyl. The forward reaction breaks OH, but target is product after substitution, so target lacks OH. The broken group in forward is OH, which is present in reactant (precursor). In retrosynthesis, we are breaking the C-O bond that was formed in forward? Actually forward: break C-O (aliphatic hydroxyl) and form C-X. In retrosynthesis, we are forming C-O? Wait we are going backwards: target has C-X (alkyl halide). To get precursors, we need to replace halogen with OH (leaving group). So the template should break C-X and form C-O. So functional_groups_broken (forward) = aliphatic halide, functional_groups_formed = aliphatic hydroxyl. But description says forward reaction breaks C-O and forms C-X. So our retrosynthetic template is opposite. The search criteria refer to forward reaction. So we should specify functional_groups_broken = ["aliphatic hydroxyl"], functional_groups_formed = ["alkyl halide"].

Let's call with those.
